seoTitle: Free Redirect Rules Generator: Apache, NGINX, Netlify
metaDescription: Convert old and new URL pairs into .htaccess, NGINX and _redirects rules with 301, 302, 307 or 308. Free; runs in your browser.
intro: Paste old and new URL pairs and get redirect rules for Apache .htaccess, an NGINX server block and a Netlify or Cloudflare Pages _redirects file, with the status code you choose.
why:
Site migrations, URL clean-ups and retired pages all need redirects, usually many at once. Writing each rule by hand for the right server, with the right syntax and escaping, is slow and a typo can send visitors to an error page or lose the ranking of the old URL.

This generator reads pairs written as old new, old -> new or old, new, one per line, and prints rules for three targets at once. Query-string sources get a rewrite condition for Apache and a comment for NGINX. You pick 301, 302, 307 or 308. Use a permanent code for moved content and test a sample of URLs after deploying. It handles simple one-to-one redirects, not pattern rules or regular expressions. The output is built in your browser.
howTo: Paste your pairs, one per line, as old new or old -> new.
Run the tool to see the Apache, NGINX and _redirects rules.
Copy the section for your server, deploy it and test several of the old URLs.

faq.q: Which status code should I use?
faq.a: Use 301 or 308 for permanent moves, which pass ranking signals to the new URL. Use 302 or 307 for temporary redirects. 307 and 308 keep the request method unchanged.

faq.q: Does it support wildcards or regex?
faq.a: No. It writes exact-path redirects, one per pair. For pattern-based rules, adapt the output by hand or use your server's own rewrite syntax.

faq.q: How are old URLs with query strings handled?
faq.a: Apache output gets a RewriteCond on the query string. For NGINX the tool prints a comment showing the if-condition to add, since location blocks do not match query strings.
No. Everything runs in your browser and nothing you paste is uploaded, stored or sent to a server, so staging or confidential configuration is safe to use here.
